collision_anatomy_disaggregation.semantic_basis: Counts represent repeated tracker exclusion events across all 200 sequential edits and 6 seeds (out of 119,400 possible ordered pairs), NOT distinct fact pairs.

wilcoxon_verification.tie_zero_convention: Standard Wilcoxon: zero-difference pairs discarded, absolute values ranked
wilcoxon_verification.interpretation: Because 3 of the 6 seeds had identical retention (diff = 0), only 3 pairs were informative (+1, +5, +13). Across 2^3 = 8 possible sign assignments, the minimum two-sided p-value is 2/8 = 0.2500, creating an exact discrete floor.

student_t_verification.distributional_assumption: Student's t assumes normality of the six seed differences. Because half the observations are zero and the other half are strictly positive, normality is violated; the test is parametric, not distribution-free.

rank_1_geometry.formula: Delta = u r^T  ==>  k_g Delta = (k_g u) r^T
rank_1_geometry.implication: For any rank-1 update, changes to all keys in collision group G lie along the identical output direction r. If two keys k_1, k_2 have cosine similarity >= 0.999, k_1 u ~= k_2 u, so the induced outputs v_1 and v_2 necessarily shift by approximately the same vector r.

feasibility_regimes.compatible_targets: Feasible: If different prompts with near-identical subject keys require compatible downstream directions, a shared v* can satisfy both.
feasibility_regimes.contradictory_targets_same_prompt: Mathematically Infeasible: Two identical prompts with conflicting target tokens cannot be resolved by any rank-1 update or any single v*.
feasibility_regimes.orthogonal_residuals_near_parallel_keys: Infeasible / Approximated: If desired residuals r_1, r_2 are orthogonal (<r_1, r_2> = 0), a single rank-1 direction r cannot satisfy both; error >= 1/sqrt(2) ||r_2||.
feasibility_regimes.relation_branching: Conditional: Sharing subject key k across different relation contexts succeeds if layers 2-11 attention routing branches the prompt context tokens.

section_2_consolidation_mathematics.c2_c3_mechanism: Arm C2/C3 uses Adam optimization on a single parameter v* in R^768 to minimize the joint cross-entropy loss sum_{i in G} L_i(v*) across all colliding facts in group G. This seeks an empirical compromise v* rather than guaranteeing exact linear algebraic satisfaction.

replay_classification.evidence: When collision group G forms, find_joint_target_value_vstar retrieves the original prompts and objects of all prior colliding facts from stored_facts, passes them through the model, and optimizes v* against their summed cross-entropy loss.
replay_classification.held_out_paraphrase_leakage_audit: CLEAN: Paraphrase prompts are never accessed during find_joint_target_value_vstar or update computation. Only canonical edit_prompt and object strings are replayed.
